question: For the 3B parameter models, does fine-tuning improve coverage at k=256 compared to the base model?
expected_answer: Yes, Llama-3B + FT achieves slightly higher coverage than Llama-3B at k=256
model_answer: The figure does not include a fine-tuned version of the 3B model—only the base Llama-3B is shown. Fine-tuning results are only displayed for the 1B model (Llama-1B + FT), so a direct comparison for the 3B model cannot be made from this figure.
